colosseumOfTheMagi.name: Colosseum of the Magi
colosseumOfTheMagi.description: (+2 spell power or knowledge once per hero)
colosseumOfTheMagi.onSelectMessage: A big show is taking place at the Colosseum today. You enter the arena and hold the audience in awe with your magical prowess. Insatiable hunger for knowledge is what makes a true mage, so you gladly accept the first prize, which is one the newest academical handbooks.
colosseumOfTheMagi.onVisitedMessage: Moderator of the Colosseum instantly recognises you but respectfully denies entrance to the competitor zone. "You probably should rather be featuring as a talent judge here!"
